question: When was the Bharat Nirman Programme launched by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2005.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Bharat Nirman is a program launched by the government of India on** 16 December 2005** that aims in providing a better life to the people in** rural areas.**
 
• A basic rural infrastructure being created by an **Indian business plan **is what is all about the Bharat Nirman.
 
• The main objective of the **scheme is to develop** the** infrastructure in rural areas and make it more developed **in comparison to urban areas.
 
• The **Ministry of Rural Development is responsible **for governing this particular scheme.
 
• For implementing this scheme, the duration is determined to be for four years. An** amount of 174000 crores **has been expected as the expenditure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Major Sectors Of The Scheme:**

 
• The government implemented** six major sectors** for the following four years of the target.

** These are as follows-**

 
• **Irrigation- **Irrigation is the first implemented sector. The government has ensured an additional one crore hectares of land for irrigation **by the year 2009.**
 
• **Roads- **Its main aim is to link 1000 population of all villages with roads and all the ST and hilly villages up to a **population of 500 are** also to be linked with the roads. A total of** 47354 habitations under Bharat Nirman have been connected out of 63940 **habitations still left to be connected and 60421 habitations were sanctioned for works in December 2012.
 
• **Housing-** 60 lakh additional houses have been constructed for the poor. In **Phase-1 under Bharat Nirman Programme, 60 lakh houses** were planned and implemented to be made all over the country under Indira Gandhi Awas Yojana during the four years starting **from 2005-06 to 2008-09.** With an** expenditure of Rs 21720.39 crore, 71.76 lakh houses **were built against this target. Constructing 120 lakh houses over a period of 5 years, i.e, from 2009-10 to 2013-14, was the target for Phase 2 under Bharat Nirman. More than 85.72 lakh houses were constructed during the scheme's first three years.
 
• **Water Supply-** The remaining** 74000 villages to be supplied with proper** drinking water is what the target ensures.
 
• **Electrification-** The scheme ensures that the remaining** 125000 villages should be supplied** with proper electricity is what it tends to ensure. It also ensures that it will supply electricity to 2.3 crore houses.
 
• **Rural Communication- **This scheme focuses on** providing telephone facilities to the remaining 66822 villages.**
